display.purpose: The word SPACEPORT across the full cover width. Uppercase, one line.

headline.purpose: The back cover claim. Max 19ch, balanced. Its first line is flame.

title.purpose: Section heads on paper pages. Uppercase.

lede.purpose: One short paragraph under a title.

body.purpose: Blurbs and list text. Italic marks asides, captions, and fine print.

label.purpose: Band, nav, edition terms, stamps. Always uppercase and tracked.

label-strong.purpose: Buttons, blurb heads, ledger heads, byline. Always uppercase and tracked.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Easing for the sticker and button transitions and the sticker slap.

motion.name: slap
motion.purpose: The sticker lands on the cover once at load.

motion.name: sticker-transition
motion.purpose: Sticker hover and active transform and shadow.

motion.name: type
motion.purpose: The last terminal command types out once when half the window is in view.

motion.name: reduced-motion

motion.purpose: All of the above stop under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.css: .ds-sticker { position: relative; width: 10.5rem; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 1rem; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; background: var(--red, #c4230f); color: var(--cream, #f6ecd6); font-family: var(--label, 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-9deg); box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.1rem rgb(40 8 0 / 0.45); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sticker::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0.4rem; border: 2px dashed rgb(246 236 214 / 0.6); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .ds-sticker-main { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.55rem; line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-sticker-sub { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-sticker:hover { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1.06); box-shadow: 0 0.9rem 1.6rem rgb(40 8 0 / 0.5); } .ds-sticker:active { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(0.98); } .ds-sticker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan, #2fe0ee); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sticker { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is one 1970s sci-fi paperback. The visitor scrolls from the front cover to the copyright page. Each section is a part of the book: an orange front cover, a navy back cover, cream interior pages, and a colophon.

The mood is loud on the cover and calm inside. The cover uses flat cover stock, one painting, and one round red sticker. The inside uses ruled lists and plain serif text. Print parts carry the structure: a publisher band, a spine, an edition list, blurbs, a ledger, and a stamp.

The page is flat color, not gradients or glass. Depth comes from objects that sit on the cover, such as the painting and the sticker. The page has one theme. It does not switch for dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: One book, read top to bottom: cover, back cover, pages, colophon.
Three surfaces: flame orange, nebula navy, cream paper.
Three type voices: wide Michroma titles, Barlow Condensed labels, Spectral text.
Red is for the download action and for marks stamped on paper.
Rules and bands divide content. Cards do not.
Motion is rare: one sticker slap, one typed command, one caret.

rules.name: The Red Means Download Rule
rules.body: A filled red shape is a download control. Elsewhere red appears only as a mark on paper: a stamp outline, a step number, one ledger head.

rules.name: The Screen Light Rule
rules.body: Cyan and violet are light from a screen. Keep them inside the illustrated window and code. The one exception is the cyan focus ring.

rules.name: The Three Stocks Rule
rules.body: Every section sits on flame, navy, or paper. Do not add a fourth surface.

rules.name: The One Title Face Rule
rules.body: Michroma sets titles and step numbers only. It never sets a sentence.

rules.name: The Labels Shout Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is always uppercase and always tracked. Spectral is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Objects Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means a thing was placed on the cover or page. Text blocks, lists, and sections stay flat.

dos: Do treat each new section as a part of the book: cover, back cover, page, or colophon.
Do put each section on flame, navy, or paper.
Do divide lists with ink rules: 3px on top, 1px between rows.
Do set every label in uppercase Barlow Condensed with tracking.
Do keep red fills for download controls.
Do tilt stuck-on objects and give them a soft, warm shadow.
Do label the window plate as an illustration.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: the slap, the typing, the caret, and the hover transitions all stop.
donts: Don't apply these rules to the native app under `crates/`.
Don't use cyan or violet outside the window, code, and the focus ring.
Don't add shadows to sections, lists, or text blocks.
Don't wrap blurbs or ledger rows in cards.
Don't add a second theme or a dark mode switch. The book has one printing.
